name: Many-flowered phlox
desc: Many-flowered phlox (Phlox multiflora): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phlox multiflora, the Rocky Mountain phlox, is a low growing perennial plant native to the Rocky Mountains and parts of the Great Basin in western North America. It has white to lavender flowers.
